candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: Egyptian state collections on loan to Hong Kong, a diplomatic gesture made legible through artefact typology rather than cultural translation.

candidates.title: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Series: Treasures of the Mughal Court from the Victoria and Albert Museum
candidates.blurb: V&A lends Mughal court objects to a museum that replicates European blockbuster models on Chinese institutional infrastructure.

candidates.title: Wonders of Imperial Carpets: Masterpieces from the Museum of Islamic Art, Doha
candidates.blurb: Doha's Islamic Art Museum rotates its holdings through Asia's newest soft-power venue; format reveals collecting philosophy more than textiles.

candidates.title: The Forbidden City and The Palace of Versailles: China-France Cultural Encounters in the Seventeenth and Eighteenth Centuries
candidates.blurb: Versailles meets the Forbidden City in a joint production calibrated for symmetry rather than surprise.

candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Kwade's sculptural pavilions installed in a former colonial prison yard; phenomenology strained through heritage adaptive reuse.

candidates.title: Anne Imhof
candidates.blurb: Imhof's durational performance work programmed into a heritage complex optimised for commercial flow.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Private collection of Cantonese export art surfaces regional production networks often elided by Beijing-centric narratives.

candidates.title: Blooming: The Art of Gardens in East and West
candidates.blurb: Comparative garden aesthetics staged in a city where land itself is the rarest luxury medium.

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice Collateral Event of the 61st International Art Exhibition – La Biennale di Venezia
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong's Venice collateral project re-shown locally, testing whether international art gestures translate without the Giardini scaffolding.

candidates.title: Live: Hong Kong Art Exhibition
candidates.blurb: Institutional survey of Hong Kong art practice, annually restaged with rotating loans from the permanent collection.

candidates.title: Dreamchasers: Stories of Hong Kong Art
candidates.blurb: Extended run of local art histories curated through individual artists' biographies rather than movements.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Western collector's silk holdings repatriated through exhibition; private taste positioned as scholarly resource.
